Third, any broader dispute resolution would need to go through AAA commercial arbitration. This approach respects the contract, honors the client's instruction for a confidential return-and-deletion resolution, and avoids a public court filing beyond what's necessary to protect the tangible materials. I'm comfortable recommending we move forward on this basis.
